about.title: Head Cross Country Coach
about.bio: I've spent years developing endurance athletes from casual runners to state competitors, focusing on aerobic development, race tactics, and the mental toughness that separates good runners from great ones. My athletes don't just get fitter — they get smarter about how they race.

hero.headline: Run Strong. Race Smart.
hero.subline: Private cross country coaching — endurance development, race tactics, and course prep for runners who want to compete at their best.

services.title: Endurance Base Building
services.description: Structured aerobic development programs targeting weekly mileage, easy pace discipline, and injury-resistant training habits.

services.title: Race Strategy & Pacing
services.description: Course-specific pacing plans, hill strategy, pack running tactics, and mental race preparation for meet day.

services.title: Course Prep & Recruiting
services.description: Pre-meet course walkthroughs, split planning, and recruiting guidance for athletes targeting college cross country programs.

testimonials.quote: My daughter went from mid-pack to top 10 at regionals in one season. The structured training and race strategy coaching made the difference.
testimonials.name: Patricia H.

testimonials.quote: I finally broke 18 minutes in the 5K after two seasons of working on pacing and aerobic base. The training approach here is the real deal.

success_stories.name: Ava S.
success_stories.story: Ava had raw endurance but her racing strategy was costing her places. We built a structured base program and taught her to race by feel rather than chasing early leaders.
success_stories.result: State Qualifier · PR by 45 sec · College Running Offer

faq.question: What age groups do you coach?
faq.answer: I work with middle school runners through adult competitive level. Training plans are always age- and experience-appropriate.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Sessions take place at local tracks, parks, and trail systems. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How do sessions work?
faq.answer: Sessions combine running workouts with coaching feedback on form, pacing, and strategy. Video analysis available on request.

faq.question: How many sessions per week should my runner do?
faq.answer: Most athletes benefit from 1–2 individual coaching sessions per week supplemented by their team practice. I tailor recommendations to your situation.

faq.question: Do you help with college recruiting?
faq.answer: Yes — I guide athletes on division-appropriate time standards, program research, and building their recruiting profile.
